lines.text: TOR notes: Jamal Shead led the way for the Raptors on Monday finishing with a team-high 20 points and a game-high 11 assists for his second consecutive double-double this season, which is a first-ever feat in his career, and the first Raptor to do so this season.
TOR notes: Shead's 27 assists over his last two games is the most by any player in the NBA in a two-game span this season.
